_meta.description: Crosstab of mean revenue by region x segment (an AGG_AVERAGE cell) decorated with an OVERLAY_ZSCORE_VS_MARGIN cell overlay: each cell's distance from its row margin in units of the row's cell SD, (cell - row_margin) / sd, the SD taken over the row's cells (divide by N). The row margin of a mean cell is the region's mean revenue, so each z says how far a segment sits above or below its region's average. Use a mean or rate cell: on a count cell the row margin is the row total, and every z comes out large and negative.
_meta.name: crosstab-zscore-vs-margin
